copy.headline: Shelter in place order lifted after Weatherford Aerospace fire threatens chemical tanks
copy.caption:
A fire at a North Texas airport billowed smoke into the air and prompted a shelter-in-place order Wednesday morning. Fire crews in Weatherford responded to a fire at Weatherford Aerospace around 8 a.m. to find a storage shed with two chemical storage tanks and three residual water tanks, according to the release.

The city said one chemical tank contained hydrochloric acid and the other nitric acid.

story.title: Shelter in place order lifted after Weatherford Aerospace fire threatens chemical tanks
story.summary: A fire at a North Texas airport billowed smoke into the air and prompted a shelter-in-place order Wednesday morning. A fire at a North Texas airport billowed smoke into the air and prompted a shelter-in-place order Wednesday morning, according to a news release from the city. Fire crews in Weatherford responded to a fire at Weatherford Aerospace around 8 a.m. to find a storage shed with two chemical storage tanks and three residual water tanks, according to the release. The city said one chemical tank contained hydrochloric acid and the other nitric acid. Each chemical, when aflame, releases toxic chemicals and can lead to explosions or rapidly accelerating fire.
